warning: SYNTHETIC DATA REGISTER. Records provenance and visibility of every generated dataset. Not Zava North Homes data.
rules: Every dataset has a visibility of public or private and a data_dictionary pointer.
Public datasets are committed under docs/ or mvp/evals and carry is_synthetic=true on every record or an explicit exemption.
Private datasets hold real OpenStreetMap map anchors or private tenant bindings and stay under support/ or the gitignored mvp/data folder.
Real map addresses are anchors only. No resident, case, safety, complaint or contractor event is attached to a real person.
